blocks.name: blobParts not an object: boolean with Boolean.prototype[Symbol.iterator]
blocks.reason: Excluded language feature under docs/contributing/cloud-agents.md: this case patches an intrinsic prototype iterator. nts currently uses fixed layouts and does not implement runtime intrinsic prototype mutation. The unchanged case is registered and explicitly blocked; ordinary iterable and non-object argument cases remain runnable.

blocks.name: Passing a FrozenArray as the blobParts array should work (FrozenArray<MessagePort>).
blocks.reason: Requires compiler-owned MessageChannel/MessagePort transfer to obtain an actual FrozenArray<MessagePort>. No available canonical provider exposes that capability, and Node message classes or a fabricated event.ports array are not substituted.

blocks.name: test FileReader InvalidStateError exception for readAsDataURL
blocks.reason: FileReader.readAsDataURL depends on a native base64 encoding capability that the package does not expose. The source implementation deliberately leaves that method unavailable pending the maintainer-owned native capability; no source transcoder, Node FileReader or fabricated data URL is used. This exact case invokes readAsDataURL, including state-only and repeated-read variants.

blocks.name: events are dispatched in the correct order for an empty blob
blocks.reason: Temporary shared provider/event-execution dependency: the ordinary-node source provider does not perform the HTML cleanup-after-running-a-callback microtask checkpoint when a FileReader event listener returns. The unchanged test awaits load before registering its loadend wait; the required same-task loadend dispatch therefore arrives before that continuation in this host. Both exact cases were executed and failed with an unexpected loadend event. Neither EventWatcher nor FileReader adds an artificial yield/task; this is not a permanent FileReader feature exclusion and needs the shared event/provider boundary fixed.
